args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

src/money.py quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP while the spec (FIN-212) and
its docstring require banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
the nightly tests in tests/test_money.py pass.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the spec (FIN-212) and its own docstring require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g., `2.665` should round to `2.66`, not `2.67`).
- Changed the import and the `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
